docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
I-tsing’s account of the Buddhist monastic life and learning in India and Sumatra in the seventh century, translated by Takakusu, with the Sanskrit learning of Nālandā (Oxford, 1896). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in Princeton Theological Seminary Library; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: A record of the Buddhist religion as practised in India and the Malay archipelago · I-ching · 1896, 320 scanned pages. Published 1896; I-tsing lived in the seventh century and his translator Junjirō Takakusu died 1945; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
